piezas.titulo: Written production: Places and basic directions
texto: Guided writing to find your way around the city: practise writing location questions and direction sequences. Structure: [Place] + «อยู่ที่ไหน» + [ครับ/ค่ะ]. Or an instruction: «ตรงไปแล้วเลี้ยวซ้าย». Write carefully, avoiding unnecessary spaces between the words.
